articles.text: ÉRZI: Mā, wǒ jiějie shénme shíhou zǒu a?
SON: Ma, when is older sister leaving?
MĀMA: Wǎnshang shíyīdiǎn zhōngde huǒchē.
MOTHER: On the 11:00 train this evening.
MĀMA: Nǐ xiǎo diǎnr shēng shuō huà. Bié bǎ ta chǎoxǐng le, ràng ta zài duō shuì yìhuǐr.
MOTHER: Speak a little more quietly. Don't wake her, let her sleep a little while longer.
ÉRZI: Ō, jiějie shuì wǔjiào na, wǒ xiǎo diǎnr shēngr. Mā, jiějie yào dàizǒude dōngxi dōu zhǔnbèihǎo le ma?
SON: Oh, sister is taking a noontime nap. I'll speak more softly. Ma, have all the things older sister is going to take along with her been gotten ready?
MĀMA: Chàbuduō le, jiù shi hái yǒu yìxiē gōngyìpǐn méiyou nònghǎo, nǐ huílaile, zhènghǎo bāngbang máng, bǎ zhèixiē dōngxi bāoqilai.
MOTHER: Just about, there are just a few handicrafts not yet taken care of. You've come back just in time to help by wrapping these things.
ÉRZI: Jiějie shi dào Měiguó qù niàn shūde, dài gōngyìpǐn gàn shénme?
SON: Sister's going to America to go to school; what is she taking handicrafts for?
MĀMA: Zài dàxuéli niàn shū zǒng huì yǒu ge hǎo péngyou, wàiguó rén xǐhuan Zhōngguó gōngyìpǐn, dàishang yìdiǎnr, sòngsong rén, bú shi hěn hǎo ma?
MOTHER: In college you're always going to have a good friend. Foreigners like Chinese handicrafts. So isn't it a good idea to take some along to give people as gifts?
ÉRZI: Hǎo, wǒ yìhuǐr jiù bāohǎo le.
SON: Okay, I'll have them wrapped in a minute.
MĀMA: Duì le, nǐ zài zhèr nòng, wǒ dào chúfáng kàn yíxia, kànkan cài hǎole méiyou.
MOTHER: Oh--you take care of this here, and I'll go take a look in the kitchen to see if the food is done.
ÉRZI: Wǎnshang hái yǒu kèren ma?
SON: Are there guests coming tonight, too?
MĀMA: Yǒu. Děng yíxia Zhōu Bómǔ hé tā érzi lái gěi nǐ jiějie sòngxíng.
MOTHER: Yes, in a little while Mrs. (Auntie) Zhōu and her son are coming over to give your sister a send-off.
ÉRZI: Mā, wǒ kàn, wǒ jiějie gēn Xiǎo Zhōu hǎoxiàng bú cuò ma!
SON: Ma, I think older sister and Xiǎo Zhōu seem to be getting along pretty well!
MĀMA: Shǎ háizi! Nǐ jiějie gēn Xiǎo Zhōu tán liàn'ài kuài yìnián le, nǐ nà bù zhīdao!
MOTHER: You dumb kid! Your sister and Xiǎo Zhōu have been in love for almost a year now. Didn't you know?!
ÉRZI: Ō! Yuánlái shi zènme huí shi. Hǎo, mā, nǐ kuài máng qu ba! Zhèi diǎnr gōngyìpǐn jiāo gěi wo le.
SON: Oh, so that's what's been going on all along. Okay, mom, you go ahead with your work. Hand the handicrafts over to me.
MĀMA: Nǐ kuài bāo, bāowánle, dào chúfáng lái bāng wo máng.
MOTHER: Get these wrapped quickly. When you're done, come to the kitchen and help me.
ÉRZI: Xíng, wǒ yìhuǐr jiù lái.
SON: Okay, I'll be there in a minute.
